title: The Pharmacy Robbery
prompt: A man walks into a pharmacy and runs out with the money from the till. The pharmacist calls the police station and, minutes later, a police officer recovers the money and takes the man away. That same afternoon the three of them go to the police station to report a robbery.
solution: The man was the pharmacist's son. His car had been stolen and he had a very important exam. He had gone to ask his mother for taxi money. She called her husband, a police officer, to take their son to the exam. As the son no longer needed the taxi money, he gave it back to his father. In the end the three of them went together to report the theft of the car.
